purpose: Recover, from PRIMARY sources only, the method the external work uses to identify the workspace band. No second-hand heuristic is used.

primary_sources.why_primary: this is the method's own repository at the commit the authority pins
the published configs and convergence traces of the very lenses used as controls

verbatim_definitions_from_the_official_r.lens_readout: at each (layer, token position) the Jacobian lens returns a ranked list of vocabulary tokens.
verbatim_definitions_from_the_official_r.workspace_band: the contiguous mid-network layer range where workspace content is read; experiments report over this band, not individual layers.
verbatim_definitions_from_the_official_r.hit: a target token is a hit if it appears at lens rank 1 at any (layer, position) in the band over the scored span.
verbatim_definitions_from_the_official_r.lens_quality_metric: pass@k = mean over items of the fraction of intermediates whose min-over-layers lens rank <= k.

the_decisive_observation.statement: The external method does not identify the band with kurtosis at all. It identifies it by WHERE LABELLED CONTENT IS READ, using vocabulary RANKS.
the_decisive_observation.consequence: the band on the positive control can be located by a procedure that is entirely external, uses ground-truth labels published with the method, and contains no threshold chosen by us
the_decisive_observation.why_this_is_stronger_than_matching_the_p: A-3 would have had us match a three-landmark qualitative description by eye. The rank-based procedure yields a band with a numeric location, on the same checkpoint we hold, and can be computed rather than judged.

labelled_evaluation_sets_acquired.note: each item carries `intermediates`, the ground-truth concept token(s) that should be readable, plus a readout position rule fixed by the source

sets.readout_position: the final prompt token, the closing period
the token immediately preceding `target`; `target` is not itself scored
the token immediately preceding `target`; rank is the min over single-token synonyms
the last newline token, end of line 1 of the couplet
the final prompt token, the last tokenizer fragment of the misspelling

external_fit_parameters_recovered_from_t.corpus: Salesforce/wikitext, wikitext-103-raw-v1, split train, text field text, max_chars 2000
external_fit_parameters_recovered_from_t.target_layer_meaning: null means the library default, the final layer, which is what EQ1 also used

comparability_with_eq1_own_fit.same_corpus_family: Salesforce/wikitext wikitext-103-raw-v1 train, which is exactly the corpus EQ1 fixed
comparability_with_eq1_own_fit.same_skip_first: the external convergence.csv records n_valid_positions = 111 for seq_len 128, which is 128 - 16 - 1; that is the library default skip_first of 16 with the final position dropped, identical to EQ1
comparability_with_eq1_own_fit.same_target_layer_rule: library default final layer in both
differences_recorded_honestly: external used dim_batch 128, EQ1 used 8; dim_batch changes only how many output dimensions share a backward pass, not the estimator
external used compile=true, EQ1 did not; this is a speed setting
external early-stopped at prompts_fitted 485 (positive control) under stop_at_delta 0.002; EQ1 fitted a fixed 600 rows per half with no early stop
external fitted ONE lens per model; EQ1 fitted two independent half-lenses in order to have a cross-fit stability check, which the external work does not have

final_identity_distance_comparison.why_not: computing it requires reading lens_A or lens_B. OD-012 forbids reading either until the convention is committed, and hard blocker 5 makes an early read a stop. It is therefore deferred to R-2, where it will be reported beside the external value.

claim_ceiling: A method recovery from primary sources. It licenses no claim of any kind.
